[\"连续的块->笛卡尔积，逗号连接的块->并集。递归解析表达式，[[A0]]解.en: Consecutive blocks -> Cartesian product; comma-separated blocks -> union. Expressions are parsed recursively: [[A0]] parses a small block, while [[A1]] parses a consecutive expression, taking the Cartesian product of the completed result and the newly parsed block via recursive calls. [[A2]] parses comma-separated blocks; because concatenation binds tighter than the comma operator, it calls [[A3]] first. For the Cartesian product, the first block uses an empty string as a placeholder, equivalent to the multiplicative identity 1.
